manifest.author_note: All 60 live payloads were written by one internal corpus author (not the defense builder). The plan asks for 30% hand-written by people outside the team; no outside authors were available, so that slice is filled by the internal author and flagged here and on the scorecard. Payload text in Indonesian, slang, or obfuscated form is test data, not product copy.

adaptive_attacker.note: Reserved for payloads from an adaptive attacker model with access to the defense code. No attacker model has been run in v1, so these 60 records are empty slots, not payloads.
